observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment capability discovery and capability intelligence projection

outcome.functionality: Provider-declared repository-toolchain resolution failures carry a bounded structured issue from capability discovery through the existing ECI verification-readiness context.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: structured investigation context is present in focused verification and a live ECI readback; service fulfillment, causal contribution to the excluded verification result, and agent-intervention reduction are not assessed.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The current same-provider relation does not prove that canonical-vm-tests was a dependency of the excluded verification obligation.

improvement_relation.basis: Focused regressions pass and the live ECI relation retains the exact selected-checkout resolution issue with both integrity-verified verification Store references.
not_measured: whether the provider capability caused or was required by the verification exclusion
whether this visibility changes implementation decisions or improves service outcomes

pressure_hypothesis.title: ECI obscures the declared input behind an unavailable provider capability
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability binding and verification readiness projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The pre-change live ECI readiness relation exposed only a clipped provider-unavailability reason for the selected same-provider capability.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve provider-declared repository-toolchain resolution findings as bounded structured context and carry them through the existing verification-readiness projection.

measurement_limits: The implementation improves traceability and discovery only; it does not repair the selected provider's checkout closure or change the verification result.
The ECI relation is exact for verification and owner-result evidence, but the unavailable same-provider capability remains identity-correlated rather than proven as an obligation dependency.
No claim is made that agent effort, execution cost, or service failure rate improved.
